ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.raw_text:
Tropical Depression Verbena caused severe floods, mudslides, and landslides in the Visayas, Mindanao, and Bicol Region of the Philippines, including flooding in parts of Bacolod City. #VerbenaPH

Around 398 families or 1,689 individuals were displaced in Bacolod City due to flooding. 

The Philippine Palace activated disaster response teams and suspended work in certain areas for safety. 

Overall damage includes widespread class suspensions in over 10,700 schools and stranded passengers due to no-sailing policies. 

The storm resulted in significant disruptions and damage across multiple regions in the country.
